answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 95 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in timber, queued in sonnet, and zenith publishes the wait time. A farm of 45 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3764 identities would post 648 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
